chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abd al-Rahman from Alaa from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the Mutamatti (one who performs Hajj al-Tamattu'), when does he visit the House? He said, 'On the Day of Nahr (Eid al-Adha).'

key_terms.الْمُتَمَتِّعِ: Mutamatti: A pilgrim who performs Umrah first, then Hajj, with a break in between.
key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Qi'dah).

ai.seo_question: When should a Mutamatti perform Tawaf al-Ifadah during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS), the specific timing for the Tawaf al-Ifadah by a Mutamatti is pinpointed to the Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah), clarifying the ritual sequence of Hajj al-Tamattu'. This establishes the legal distinction between the Ihram state and the completion of the major pilgrimage rites, a key point in Shia fiqh regarding the validity of the Umrah component.
